name: failure-handler-undoes-cancel
rule: a failure handler reads the job's current state before it moves it, so it cannot undo a cancel
covers: A failure handler reads the job's current state before it moves the job
message: requeue sync jobs from the failure handler
body: When a sync attempt throws, the failure handler puts the job back to queued while attempts remain and marks it failed after the last one. Moves go through moveJob, which refuses edges the state machine does not allow.
